roads.name: Heritage Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 10 curves in 4.0 miles.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 593 to 911 ft, with 422 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.87 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Glidden Drive
words: Curve after curve after curve: 62 in 5.6 miles, about 11 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 585 to 606 ft, with 174 ft of up and down along the way.
6 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
